title: Procedural Memory
description: Procedural memory record representing automated action rules derived from semantic knowledge

description.description: Description of what this procedure does

type.description: Type of trigger that activates this procedure

pattern.description: Pattern to match against for triggering

conditions.description: Additional conditions that must be met

target.description: Target of the action (e.g. knowledge ID, search query)

actions.description: Actions to perform when this procedure is triggered

source_semantic_ids.description: Semantic memory IDs this procedure was derived from

enabled.description: Whether this procedure is currently active

priority.description: Priority for ordering when multiple procedures match

triggered_count.description: Number of times this procedure has been triggered

success_count.description: Number of times this procedure executed successfully

last_triggered_at.description: When this procedure was last triggered
